lucascodev.aura-datadock-db/activated.comment: The extension started. Used to count active installations.

lucascodev.aura-datadock-db/command.used.comment: A command of the extension ran. Used to learn which features are used.

command.comment: Identifier of the command, such as runQuery or showDiagram.

lucascodev.aura-datadock-db/connection.o.comment: A database connection opened. Never includes host, port, user, database or names.

driver.comment: Database type: postgres, mysql or mariadb.

source.comment: Where the connection came from: docker or saved.

ssh.comment: Whether the connection goes through an SSH tunnel.

remote.comment: Whether the database is outside the local machine.

editor.comment: Name of the editor, such as Visual Studio Code or Cursor.
